scope: Q1 shared integer row/tile candidate versus prior and matched mx Vulkan, with Q2 control. Twelve fixed development calls; not final qualification.

meta.limitations: Short-lived processes between samples may be missed; disappeared/new and inaccessible processes are retained as coverage limits. Unavailable GPU counters are not zero.

interpretation: Q1 shared integer rows and tiles improve prefill and decode. Q2 unchanged-path control is stable. Both decode rates remain below matched mx Vulkan. Native CPU/Vulkan operators pass; focused model, split, depth and final qualification remain open. Every planned sample and all contention flags are retained.
